summary: This Form 6-K reports shareholder approvals at a Class A meeting and an extraordinary general meeting of High-Trend International Group on May 7, 2026. The Class A shareholders approved increasing Class B ordinary share voting rights from 20 to 100 votes per share, and authorized the board to consolidate Class A shares up to a 1000:1 ratio over two years. The general meeting approved increasing authorized share capital from US$1.25M to US$5.275M and confirmed the voting rights increase. These are governance/capital structure changes, not a special-situation event.
